notes.41: Question 41 , the idea of ordinateur was successfully communicated by a reasonable number of candidates, and the one-word answer was sufficient to gain the mark. Several alternative spellings of ordinateur were accepted. Some candidates incorrectly answered vivre sans ordinateur which was the opposite of the concept required. Question 42 proved to be the most challenging question on the exercise. One of two concepts was required: either that Agathe was never alone or that she was always with her family/parents. For the first concept, a form of negative was required, such as jamais seule or pas seule and in the second there were several ways of expressing the idea. Answers such as elle était avec ses parents tout le temps or elle était avec sa famille 24h sur 24h clearly conveyed the concept. Question 43 was well answered by many candidates. The notion of a comparative was required, and where candidates did not gain the mark it was often because though they had recognised and conveyed the idea of responsable , they omitted the comparative plus .
